scenarios.name: untaps-a-permanent-that-enters-tapped
scenarios.why: 'Whenever a permanent you control enters tapped, untap it': Tranquil Cove enters tapped, so Amulet of Vigor's trigger untaps it. Its own enters trigger still gains 1 life.

scenarios.name: without-the-amulet-a-tapland-stays-tapped
scenarios.why: Control: with no Amulet of Vigor the tapland remains tapped after entering.
